input.prompt: Animate the exact male celestial dragon sovereign in the reference as a formidable battle commander. A 5 second single locked shot, same reference as first and last frames. Preserve his face, masculine identity, armor, sword and orb. The sword hand on the LEFT of the image keeps a firm grip on the sword; do not swap hands or add weapons. 0–0.8 seconds: brace his torso, square his shoulders and fix a stern gaze directly forward. 0.8–2.3 seconds: visibly bend the orb-bearing elbow on the RIGHT of the image, raise the forearm and orb about one head height toward the chest, then drive the forearm a short distance forward in a firm commanding gesture. His shoulders and upper torso turn together with physical weight, chest open and chin level. Fingers hold a strong controlled shape, wrist straight. Sword arm remains grounded, sword solid and stable. Wide sleeves and long hair react with strong delayed motion; dragon silhouettes subtly spread their wings. 2.3–3 seconds: briefly hold the imposing command pose. 3–5 seconds: deliberately retract and lower the orb arm, settle shoulders and clothing, return exactly to the starting composition, hand positions and expression for a seamless loop. Clear visible arm and torso action, deliberate acceleration and controlled stops. Fixed camera, full original framing, no cuts, no audio.
